name: line-oss-crm
description: Open-source LINE Official Account CRM/marketing automation

scripts.deploy:client: node scripts/with-client.mjs --client "$CLIENT_CONFIG" --web-env-out apps/web/.env.production.local --render-only && pnpm --filter web build && node scripts/with-client.mjs --client "$CLIENT_CONFIG" -- deploy
scripts.db:migrate:client: node scripts/with-client.mjs --client "$CLIENT_CONFIG" -- d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.toml
